title: Word search
statementMd:
Given a grid of letters, return whether `word` can be built from sequentially adjacent (up, down, left, right) cells, using each cell at most once.

**Example:** `word_search([["A", "B", "C", "E"], ["S", "F", "C", "S"], ["A", "D", "E"…, "ABCCED")` returns `true`.
hints: DFS from every cell, marking visited.
